metadata.name: Foggy Window Wipe
metadata.description:
For Foggy Window Wipe:

Description

A photo behind a fogged, wet window that you wipe clean with your cursor. Click and drag to clear the glass, scroll to change the wipe size. Every stroke leaves soft streaks and beads of water along its edges, drops gather and run down through
